file_pattern: *.olean in Mathlib and dependency build/lib directories
manifest_encoding: sorted relative path + NUL + hex SHA-256 + LF for each file
scope: Identity of the compiled inputs used for this client native gate, not a fresh Mathlib rebuild or application environment fingerprint. File count and size match the validation-version-2 record; the manifest differs because the olean files were built on a different machine.
